description: Fork of exp742 (bf16 head + xent fix, drifted +9 mb at step 2400 before kill). Adds vanilla-equivalent grad clip on non-LUT params: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(decay_params + tok_emb_params + nodecay_params, 1.0). LUT body left unclipped (its grad norm naturally ~36 at 251 M params; clip(1.0) would over-constrain). Tests whether vanilla's grad clip was the silent protector against bf16-head drift. Compare to exp737 v2 = 1.3872.
